findings.passage: “As my own experience has shown,” he declared in his speech, “it doesn’t matter even if folks are able to send acceptable voter ID with their absentee ballot applications and completed ballots. It’s unavoidable that voter ID laws will still flag many of them.”
findings.note: Quoted by Queerty (article dated 2021-06-17) from his first House floor speech against SB 202; the article places it in 2021 but the speech date is not stated. He describes being flagged as a non-citizen in 2008 on an absentee request and submitting proof of citizenship four times.
